widths.note: east of Dalton; printed 50' west of Dalton

notes: North is up. Courtland printed 'COURTLAND (FLORENCE)'; it ends at Dalton on the west (Dalton's west line is continuous; American Oak Leather Co. beyond on sheet 69) and at Denman on the east (sheet 71 confirms the armory block closes it). Hoeffer (20 ft, no suffix printed) runs from Kenner north across Courtland into sheet 78. President Pl. printed 'PRESIDENT PL. (LINCOLN)', runs Kenner to Hopkins along the west side of Lincoln Park; it does not line up with Hoeffer (about 150 px apart). Denman ends at Kenner (Lincoln Park south of it). Harriet and Louisa run south from Hopkins into sheet 59/60. Hopkins is 50' west of Dalton and 80' east of Dalton along Lincoln Park; centre taken from both block lines. Lincoln Park paths and the lake are not streets. Area east of Denman between Courtland and Kenner is drawn only as an outline (adjoining sheet).
